pythonFunction.name: run_planning_calculation
pythonFunction.description: Runs deterministic financial planning calculations using the customer's real account figures from account_snapshot. Supports: emergency_fund_gap (target vs current), debt_vs_invest (guaranteed return of debt payoff vs investment yield comparison), payoff_timeline (months to pay off a loan at current payment), and allocation_split (proposed savings/debt allocation). Returns both numeric results and an explicit agent_action instruction for how to present them as a side-by-side comparison — the agent must never invent numbers or framing. Only call after account_snapshot is populated.
